_meta.schema: Style Dictionary-style subset (templates/design-system.md): leaves carry { value, type }; {dotted.path} is a reference.
_meta.system: The harness's own landing page (docs/index.html) — an evidence layer for agent-driven development, infrastructure other repos self-host. No product UI and no end-users; the page is the harness's one external-facing artifact.
_meta.note: Three tiers: primitive (raw, named by what it IS) -> semantic (named by what it is FOR; the contract consuming code binds to) -> component (per-component narrowing of a semantic value). This capture (#241) has no component-only chrome — every literal the page renders resolves at primitive/semantic, so the component tier is declared empty rather than populated with an invented narrowing.
_meta.capture: Every value here is byte-identical to what docs/index.html renders today via its hand-authored :root block (issue #241, capture not redesign). #242 builds the generator that writes tokens.json back into that block; this issue only stands up the source of truth.

primitive._comment: The neutral ramp and the four loop hues, each already a de-facto three-step ramp (base/soft/ink) in the page's hand-authored :root block.

semantic._comment: The roles the page actually consumes: surface, text, border, and one role per loop (accent/soft/ink) for each of the four loop cards.

component._comment: Empty in this capture (#241) — no value in today's :root block is genuinely single-use chrome; every literal resolves through primitive -> semantic. A future entry narrows a semantic value for exactly one component, per templates/design-system.md.
